resources.string: Offline suggestions. Tap to insert; Space and Enter keep their normal actions.
Disabled in sensitive fields. Suggestions do not learn personal input.

Uses offline dictionaries to suggest next words after you commit text. Tap a suggestion to insert it. Space and Enter never choose a next-word suggestion.\n\nSuggestions are disabled in password and other sensitive fields. This suggestion feature does not learn personal habits or save input records.
